# agy-github-worker [![GitHub Repo](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-rrivera%2Fagy--github--worker-blue.svg)](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-89b4fa.svg)](https://antigravity.google) Core Antigravity plugin providing the autonomous `/github-worker` skill for agent-ready GitHub issue workflows. --- ## Overview `agy-github-worker` is a fully autonomous issue worker engine built specifically for Antigravity: - **Autonomous Issue Polling & Scoped Targeting**: Scans target repositories for issues opted in via `agent-ready`. Supports targeting specific tickets (`/github-worker for issue #12`), milestones (`for the v1.0 milestone`), labels (`with priority:high label`), or baseline branches (`/github-worker against develop branch`). - **Persistent Policy Configuration (`/setup-github-worker`)**: Interactively establishes and records project or global worker policies directly in `AGENTS.md` (baseline branch, merge policy, CI gating), eliminating repetitive instructions across runs. - **Workflow State Management**: Manages state progression through labels (`status:todo`, `status:in-progress`, `status:waiting-on-user`, `status:in-review`, `status:done`). - **Parallel Subagent Dispatch**: Spawns isolated `architect` subagents in dedicated git worktrees (`.worktrees/issue-`), isolating builds and tests. - **Dynamic Baseline & Auto-Rebase**: Automatically detects the repository's default branch (or user-specified base branch), fetches upstream changes, rebases cleanly, and resolves merge conflicts before testing and PR submission. - **TDD Quality Gate**: Enforces Test-Driven Development (Red -> Green -> Refactor) and empirical verification before opening Pull Requests. - **CI / GitHub Actions Gating**: Automatically watches PR status checks on repositories with active GitHub Actions workflows, ensuring all CI tests pass before dispatching peer reviewers. - **3-Axis Peer Code Review**: Automatically dispatches parallel read-only review subagents (`spec-reviewer`, `standards-reviewer`, `security-reviewer`) to evaluate changes against observable predicates. - **Rate-Limit Awareness**: Provides guidance and proactive quota checks via GitHub API rate-limit endpoints. - **Prompt Injection Defense**: Automatically strips and ignores all invisible HTML/Markdown comments (``) from issue descriptions and human comments (allowing only `` for state tracking), mitigating malicious hidden prompt injection. - **Manual Merge Safety**: Keeps approved PRs in `status:in-review` for human approval by default, with explicit user opt-in for automated squash-merging. --- ## Companion UI Board Looking for the live Kanban auxiliary side pane? Install the standalone companion UI plugin: 👉 [**`rrivera/agy-github-worker-board`**](https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker-board) The companion board runs as an isolated sidecar webview in Antigravity's auxiliary side pane, providing real-time issue cards and GitHub navigation with zero AI token overhead. --- ## Included Skills This plugin provides two complementary skills: - [**`/github-worker`**](skills/github-worker/): The core autonomous execution engine. Polls `agent-ready` issues, creates isolated git worktrees, enforces TDD, rebases against the baseline branch, gates on GitHub Actions CI, runs 3-axis peer code reviews (`spec`, `standards`, `security`), and manages PR workflows. - [**`/setup-github-worker`**](skills/setup-github-worker/): Interactive configuration wizard. Sets up and persists project or global defaults for baseline branch, merge policy (`manual` vs `auto-merge`), and CI gating rules inside `AGENTS.md`. --- ## Installation in Antigravity Install directly from GitHub via the Antigravity CLI: ```bash # Install the core issue worker skill agy plugin install https://github.com/rrivera/agy-github-worker ``` Alternatively, you can copy the skills directly into your global skills directory: ```bash mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/skills cp -r skills/* ~/.gemini/config/skills/ ``` Restart Antigravity. The `/github-worker` and `/setup-github-worker` slash commands will be available across all your workspaces. --- ## Configuration (`/setup-github-worker`) Instead of repeatedly specifying branch targets, merge policies, or CI rules in your prompts, run `/setup-github-worker` to establish persistent repository or global defaults. ### Interactive Setup Wizard ```text /setup-github-worker ``` The wizard guides you through three key decisions and codifies your preferences into an isolated, delimited policy block inside your project's `AGENTS.md` (or globally in `~/.gemini/config/rules/AGENTS.md`): ```markdown ## GitHub Worker Policy - **Base Branch**: main - **Merge Policy**: manual - **CI Gating**: strict - **Force Model Tier**: pro # optional manual override: pro | flash | inherit ``` ### Configurable Options | Option | Values | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Base Branch** | `` | Detected default branch (e.g. `main`) | The upstream branch that feature worktrees branch from, rebase against, and target in PRs (e.g. `main`, `develop`, `release/*`). Configured via `/setup-github-worker`. | | **Merge Policy** | `manual` \| `auto-merge` | `manual` | • **`manual`**: Safe default. Completes worktrees, passes CI, collects 3 peer reviews, sets `status:in-review`, and pauses for human approval.
• **`auto-merge`**: Autonomous completion. Automatically squash-merges the PR, deletes the remote branch, and marks `status:done` once CI passes and all 3 peer reviews approve. Configured via `/setup-github-worker`. | | **CI Gating** | `strict` \| `permissive` | `strict` | • **`strict`**: Monitors GitHub Actions workflow runs on open PRs and blocks peer review dispatch until all checks succeed.
• **`permissive`**: Bypasses GitHub Actions status polling, relying strictly on the local test suite executed during development. Configured via `/setup-github-worker`. | | **Force Model Tier** | `pro` \| `flash` \| `inherit` | *(Unspecified / Role Matrix)* | *Optional manual setting in `AGENTS.md`*:
• **Unspecified (Default)**: The orchestrator automatically passes role-matched tiers to `invoke_subagent`—`architect` **always** uses `"pro"` (the flagship model, e.g. Argon 4) even inside a Flash session, while reviewers follow the PR complexity matrix and mechanical workers use `"flash"`.
• **`pro`**: Forces `"pro"` across all subagents (`architect` and all reviewers).
• **`flash`**: Forces `"flash"` across all subagents.
• **`inherit`**: Subagents inherit the active orchestrator session model. | ### Precedence Hierarchy When `/github-worker` executes, preferences are resolved in the following order: 1. **Prompt Instructions**: Any explicit request in your prompt takes highest priority (e.g., `/github-worker against develop branch`, `auto-merge on approval`). 2. **Project Policy (`./AGENTS.md` or `.agents/rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Checked next for the `` section. 3. **Global Policy (`~/.gemini/config/rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Used if no project-level policy exists. 4. **Built-in Defaults**: Detected repository default branch, `manual` merge policy, and `strict` CI gating. --- ## Usage ### 1. Interactive Policy Setup Run the setup wizard to configure or update your repository preferences: ```text /setup-github-worker ``` ### 2. Default Run (Poll All Actionable `agent-ready` Issues Against Configured Base) ```text /github-worker ``` ### 3. Targeting a Specific Baseline Branch ```text /github-worker against develop branch /github-worker targeting staging ``` ### 4. Targeted Issue Run ```text /github-worker for issue #12 /github-worker resolve issues 12 and 15 ``` ### 5. Milestone or Label Filtered Run ```text /github-worker for the v1.0 milestone /github-worker with priority:high label ``` ### 6. Multi-Option Targeting & Auto-Merge ```text /github-worker for issue #12 against develop branch. Proceed to merge on approval and mark done without my review. ``` --- ## License MIT
